_comment: Copy this file to mvconfig.json (gitignored) and edit. Any absent file/section/key falls back to the documented default; a malformed file warns to stderr and is ignored. JSON has no comments, so the _comment fields below document each key.

web._comment_host: Bind address for `python main.py web`. Default 127.0.0.1 (local only). Use 0.0.0.0 to reach the console from your LAN IP and your Tailscale IP. SECURITY: binding to anything other than 127.0.0.1/localhost/::1 REQUIRES a non-empty token below, or the server refuses to start.
web._comment_port: Port for the web console. Default 8765.
web._comment_token: Shared secret that protects EVERY /api/* request (all reads AND all destructive actions). null/empty = NO auth (local dev default). When set, clients must present it via the mv_token cookie, the X-MediaVault-Token header, or a ?token= query param; the local browser is auto-opened with the token in the URL. Set a long random string before exposing the console on a network.

tmdb._comment_api_key: Optional TMDB API key for metadata lookups. null/empty = unset.
